text:
`python3 -m unittest` now passes: 16 tests, all OK. I didn't modify any tests. The fixes in `catalog/`:

- **`search.py`**: it imported `normalize` from a module that doesn't exist (`catalog.nonexistent`). It now imports from `catalog.text`.
- **`books.py`**: `parse_book` left the year as a string. It now converts it to an int.
- **`fees.py`**: `late_fee` added the daily fee to the number of days. It now multiplies them.
- **`members.py`**: `MAX_BORROWED` was 3, but the policy comment and the tests say 5. It is now 5.
- **`inventory.py`**: `recent(n)` returned `n + 1` events because of an off-by-one in the slice. It now returns the last `n`.
- **`factory.py`**: `sample_books()` was missing the third book. I added `Book("Emma", "Austen", 1815, 1)`. The tests only check the title, so the author, year and copy count are my choice.
